text:
Type: vintage-style round wall clock
Use: telling the time at a glance; living room, kitchen, dining room, home office
Style: traditional, retro, farmhouse
Materials: painted metal case, chrome-finish inner ring, glass front, printed dial
Colors: warm cream beige, aged parchment dial, black numerals and hands, silver
Shape: large round face framed by a deep rolled rim, black Roman numerals and diamond markers, ornate spade hands, station-clock look, medium visual weight
Feel: nostalgic, warm, classic, homey
Goes with: dark or warm wood, cream walls, brass or chrome accents; traditional, farmhouse or vintage rooms
